about: Thunder Bay sits at the western end of Lake Superior in northwestern Ontario, formed by amalgamating the former cities of Fort William and Port Arthur. It is a Great Lakes port and regional service centre, with grain elevators on the waterfront and the Sleeping Giant headland across the bay. The city is a gateway to the boreal Shield and to road and rail links toward Winnipeg and southern Ontario. About 109,000 people live in Thunder Bay.
